package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
)

func TestOnboardingActionRepositoryCanonicalLifecycleAndFrozenReplay(t *testing.T) {
	databaseURL := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("TEACHER_TEST_DATABASE_URL"))
	if databaseURL == "" {
		t.Skip("TEACHER_TEST_DATABASE_URL is not configured")
	}
	config, err := pgxpool.ParseConfig(databaseURL)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, strings.HasSuffix(config.ConnConfig.Database, "_test"), "TEACHER_TEST_DATABASE_URL must target a database ending in _test")
	pool, err := pgxpool.NewWithConfig(context.Background(), config)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	defer pool.Close()
	ctx := context.Background()
	require.NoError(t, pool.Ping(ctx))

	studentID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	teacherID := "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
	dialogID := "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
	sourceID := "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"
	defer func() {
		_, _ = pool.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM teacher_onboarding_interaction WHERE personal_teacher_id=$1`, teacherID)
		_, _ = pool.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM teacher_onboarding_action_receipt WHERE student_id=$1`, studentID)
		_, _ = pool.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM personal_teacher WHERE id=$1`, teacherID)
	}()
	_, err = pool.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO personal_teacher (id,student_id,teacher_profile_id,language,communication_style,pedagogy_profile,hint_policy,intervention_mode,created_at,updated_at) VALUES ($1,$2,'s2-test','ru','friendly','progressive','balanced','quiet',now(),now()) ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING`, teacherID, studentID)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	store := OnboardingActionRepository{Pool: pool}
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 9, 18, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	legacyRequest := domain.AssistantUIActionRequest{Schema: domain.AssistantUIActionSchema, DialogID: dialogID, MessageID: sourceID, MessageVersion: 1, BlockID: "onboarding.direction.d0.v1", ActionID: "direction.backend", IdempotencyKey: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555"}
	legacy, err := domain.NewOnboardingActionReceiptForMode(legacyRequest, studentID, teacherID, "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666", now, now.Add(time.Minute), domain.OnboardingActionExecutionLegacy)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	stored, created, err := store.Claim(ctx, legacy)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, created)
	require.Equal(t, domain.OnboardingActionExecutionLegacy, stored.ExecutionMode)
	require.NoError(t, store.Reject(ctx, legacy.IdempotencyKey, legacy.ClaimToken, now.Add(time.Second)))
	legacyReplay := legacy
	legacyReplay.ClaimToken = "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777"
	legacyReplay.ExecutionMode = domain.OnboardingActionExecutionCanonical
	legacyReplay.CanonicalMessageCommandID = domain.DeterministicOnboardingUUID("canonical-student", legacyReplay.IdempotencyKey)
	replayedLegacy, created, err := store.Claim(ctx, legacyReplay)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.False(t, created)
	require.Equal(t, domain.OnboardingActionExecutionLegacy, replayedLegacy.ExecutionMode, "stored mode must win after flag changes")

	canonicalRequest := legacyRequest
	canonicalRequest.IdempotencyKey = "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888"
	canonicalRequest.BlockID = "onboarding.experience.d0.v1"
	canonicalRequest.ActionID = "experience.basic"
	canonical, err := domain.NewOnboardingActionReceiptForMode(canonicalRequest, studentID, teacherID, "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999", now.Add(2*time.Second), now.Add(2*time.Minute), domain.OnboardingActionExecutionCanonical)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	interaction := domain.TeacherOnboardingInteraction{
		ID: "eeeeeeee-eeee-4eee-8eee-eeeeeeeeeeee", DialogID: dialogID, StudentID: studentID, PersonalTeacherID: teacherID,
		PromptMessageID: sourceID, PromptMessageVersion: 1, PromptAssistantUIDigest: strings.Repeat("a", 64),
		SlotCode: domain.TeacherOnboardingSlotExperience, SessionSchemaVersion: 1, State: domain.TeacherOnboardingInteractionActive,
		CreatedAt: now.Add(time.Second), UpdatedAt: now.Add(time.Second),
	}
	_, interactionCreated, err := (TeacherOnboardingTurnRepository{Pool: pool}).EnsureActiveInteraction(ctx, interaction)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, interactionCreated)
	stored, created, err = store.Claim(ctx, canonical)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, created)
	require.Equal(t, canonical.CanonicalMessageCommandID, stored.CanonicalMessageCommandID)
	canonicalMessageID := "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa"
	materialized, err := store.CompleteCanonical(ctx, canonical.IdempotencyKey, canonical.ClaimToken, canonicalMessageID, now.Add(3*time.Second))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, domain.OnboardingReceiptMaterialized, materialized.Status)
	require.Equal(t, canonicalMessageID, materialized.CanonicalStudentMessageID)
	require.Empty(t, materialized.ClaimToken)

	canonicalReplay := canonical
	canonicalReplay.ClaimToken = "bbbbbbbb-bbbb-4bbb-8bbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb"
	replayed, created, err := store.Claim(ctx, canonicalReplay)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.False(t, created)
	require.Equal(t, domain.OnboardingReceiptMaterialized, replayed.Status)
	require.Equal(t, materialized.CanonicalStudentMessageID, replayed.CanonicalStudentMessageID)

	differentKey := canonical
	differentKey.IdempotencyKey = "cccccccc-cccc-4ccc-8ccc-cccccccccccc"
	differentKey.ClaimToken = "dddddddd-dddd-4ddd-8ddd-dddddddddddd"
	_, _, err = store.Claim(ctx, differentKey)
	require.True(t, errors.Is(err, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict), "different key for same source action must conflict: %v", err)
}
